scenarios.prompt: Use the mkt-manager skill. Review landing.html against brief.md for brand consistency, copy quality and SEO. Do not publish or send anything. Save the consolidated report in .skilloffice/reports/.
Use the dev-manager skill. The test in test/price.test.js fails. Fix the bug using your bug-fix playbook. Run tests with: node --test. Save the consolidated report in .skilloffice/reports/.

Use the sls-manager skill. Prepare me for the discovery call with Lakeside Outfitters using prospect-notes.md and wholesale-offer.md, and draft a follow-up email for after the call. Do not send anything and do not quote prices. Save the consolidated report in .skilloffice/reports/.
Use the pm-manager skill. Review prd-trail-finder.md and tell me what must change before engineering can start. Do not commit to any dates. Save the consolidated report in .skilloffice/reports/.

Use the dsn-manager skill. Review index.html and styles.css for design quality, accessibility, responsiveness and generic AI-looking patterns, against our brand. Do not publish anything. Save the consolidated report in .skilloffice/reports/.
Use the qa-manager skill. Review the test suite for src/shipping.js, design the missing test cases and add them. Run tests with: node --test. Save the consolidated report in .skilloffice/reports/.

Use the ops-manager skill. Review .github/workflows/deploy.yml, the Dockerfile and k8s/deployment.yaml for reliability and security before we deploy, and give a go or no-go. Do not deploy, apply or push anything. Save the consolidated report in .skilloffice/reports/.

Use the sec-manager skill. This is our own code. Review src/orders.js for security problems, including exposed secrets, and tell us what to fix first. Do not run anything against live systems. Save the consolidated report in .skilloffice/reports/.

Use the data-manager skill. Using orders_daily.csv, explain what drove the revenue change in October 2026 compared with August and September, with the numbers to support it. Save the consolidated report in .skilloffice/reports/.
Use the sup-manager skill. Triage the tickets in tickets.md and draft replies for each. Do not send anything. Follow the policy excerpt. Save the consolidated report in .skilloffice/reports/.

Use the fin-manager skill. Reconcile bank_statement_oct.csv against ledger_cash_oct.csv for October 2026, explain every difference and propose the adjusting journal entries. Do not post anything. Save the consolidated report in .skilloffice/reports/.
Use the legal-manager skill. Review vendor-agreement.md before we sign it, rate the risks and suggest redlines. Do not sign or send anything. Save the consolidated report in .skilloffice/reports/.

Use the hr-manager skill. Review job-ad-draft.md and rewrite it as a fair, legally safe job ad for a customer support specialist, with an interview kit. Do not post anything. Save the consolidated report in .skilloffice/reports/.

Use the exe-manager skill. Stress-test business-case-retail-store.md and write a one-page decision memo for the founders. Do not invent market data. Save the consolidated report in .skilloffice/reports/.
